DischargeLineInnerDiameter.title: Discharge Line Inner Diameter
DischargeLineInnerDiameter.description: Inner diameter of the pump discharge line.

DischargeLineLength.title: Discharge Line Length
DischargeLineLength.description: Length of the pump discharge line.

ReelWrapWidth.title: Reel Wrap Width
ReelWrapWidth.description: Width of the reel core. This is the inside dimension.

ReelLength.title: Reel Length
ReelLength.description: Length of the coiled tubing remaining on the reel.

ReelOuterDiameter.title: Reel Outer Diameter
ReelOuterDiameter.description: Outside diameter of the coiled tubing reel.

CoreOuterDiameter.title: Core Outer Diameter
CoreOuterDiameter.description: Outside diameter of the reel core that the coiled tubing is wrapped around.

IsInjectorStackUp.title: Use Injector Stack Up
IsInjectorStackUp.description: True/false flag to indicate an injector stack up is present.

InjectorStackUpHeight.title: Injector Stack Up Height
InjectorStackUpHeight.description: The length of tubing from the end of the coil reel to the rotary kelly bushing. This length includes the tubing in the hole and the tubing on the reel. This measurement takes into account the 20 or so feet of tubing that is being straightened and pushed through the injector head.

IsUmbilicalInside.title: Is Umbilical Inside
IsUmbilicalInside.description: True/false flag to account for the wireline inside the coiled tubing.
